cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

project(rdrhook)

file(GLOB_RECURSE PROJECT_SOURCE_FILES "src/*.h" "src/*.hpp" "src/*.cpp" "src/*.c")

# Add the generated natives file explicitly (generated by generate_natives target)
set(GENERATED_NATIVES_CPP "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/js/JSNativesGenerated.cpp")
list(APPEND PROJECT_SOURCE_FILES ${GENERATED_NATIVES_CPP})
file(GLOB_RECURSE SHARED_SOURCE_FILES
  # Shared headers
  "${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/log/*.h"
  "${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/memory/*.h"
  "${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/utils/*.h"
)

macro(GroupSources curdir groupindex)
  file(GLOB children RELATIVE ${curdir} ${curdir}/*)

  foreach(child ${children})
    if(IS_DIRECTORY ${curdir}/${child})
      GroupSources(${curdir}/${child} ${groupindex}/${child})
    else()

      string(REPLACE "/" "\\" groupname ${groupindex})

      source_group(${groupname} FILES ${curdir}/${child})
    endif()
  endforeach()
endmacro()

GroupSources(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src "Source Files")
GroupSources(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources "Resource Files")
GroupSources(${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/src "Shared")

# Create library
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_FILES}
  ${SHARED_SOURCE_FILES}
)

# Include directories
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
  ${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/log
  ${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/memory
  ${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/utils
)

# Find vcpkg packages
find_package(JavaScriptCore CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(toml11 CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(spdlog CONFIG REQUIRED)

# Link libraries from vcpkg
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  minhook::minhook
  JavaScriptCore::JavaScriptCore
  JavaScriptCore::WTF
  JavaScriptCore::bmalloc
  JavaScriptCore::icu-dt
  JavaScriptCore::icu-in
  JavaScriptCore::icu-uc
  toml11::toml11
  spdlog::spdlog
  # System libraries required by JavaScriptCore
  ws2_32
  winmm
  dbghelp
  Synchronization

  clang_rt.builtins-x86_64.lib
)

# Compiler definitions
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
  CXX_COMPILER_ID="${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}"
  UNICODE
  _UNICODE
  _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
  # Prevent Windows.h from defining min/max macros
  NOMINMAX
  WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
  # Required for MSVC runtime with clang-cl
  _MT
  $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:_DEBUG>
  # JavaScriptCore static linking macros
  STATICALLY_LINKED_WITH_JavaScriptCore
  STATICALLY_LINKED_WITH_WTF
  STATICALLY_LINKED_WITH_bmalloc
)

# Target properties
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
  CXX_STANDARD 20
  CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/Debug"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/Release"
  LINK_FLAGS_RELEASE "/OPT:REF /OPT:ICF"
)

# Precompiled headers (disabled for clang-cl compatibility)
# target_precompile_headers(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE src/stdafx.h)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Depend on generate_natives target to ensure JSNativesGenerated.cpp is up-to-date
add_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} generate_natives)

# Copy static files at configure time
file(COPY "${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/static/" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/Release")
file(COPY "${RDRHOOK_SHARED}/static/" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/Debug")

# Note: JavaScript modules (natives.js, core.js) are no longer needed
# All natives and core functions are now registered directly in C++
